fun plan(): Evidence {
    val taskContext = readFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
    val gather = readGather(taskContext)
    val feedback = readFeedback(taskContext)
    val findings = readPlanToCodeCells(gather)
    val gradedFindings = gradeFindings(findings, feedback)
    val evidence = makeEvidence(gather, gradedFindings)
    writeFile(path = "/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content = evidence)
    val completion = noop(message = "Code-implements-plan judge complete: evidence written with no gather findings to grade.")
    return evidence
}
